repairs.quote: Swain frees the demon, which deals (15/25/35 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage and drains (15/30/45 + (5% Ability Power) + (1.5% bonus Health)) Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns. After 2 seconds and every 8 seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals (150/250/350 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 1.5s. Healing is reduced to 10% against non-champions. Depletes 10 Demonic Energy per second. After 5 seconds, this increases to 15. Regenerates 20 Demonic Energy per second while draining from champions.
